pages.text:
Enchants items and books with FE, Lapis Lazuli and Liquid Experience, with no table and no luck.
Pick its target in the GUI: every enchantment the item in it supports (all of them with no item, or for a Book), up to its top level. Type in the search box to find one by name. Click a name for its top level or to clear it; - and + step a level. Enchantments that clash with one you pick are dropped. Treasure enchantments are off unless the config allows them.
Closing the GUI clears the target, once anything left in the input is done, unless the enchanter is automated.

# Costs
Each level gained costs Lapis equal to the level, and the vanilla enchanting cost of that level in Liquid Experience (that many XP levels, at 20 mB a point). An item that already has some of the target pays only for what it gains; one that has all of it passes straight through. A Book becomes an Enchanted Book.
# Automation
Sides: item input (items and Lapis), output, Liquid Experience in. An automated enchanter (auto-eject on, a Wired Machine Link, or a conduit, hopper or chest on an item face) keeps its target when you close the GUI. The Settings Card copies the target. Speed and Energy upgrades.
